computed_method: Reconstruct immutable legacy action-stage parser from each original 16x7 plan and original cached forecast metadata. Apply the exact frozen typed_gate_effect only to inspect its existing requirements, not to reselect or modify decisions. Join to saved full journal rejection reasons and belief transitions. Read actual LIBERO90 benchmark task language and frozen entity/relation binding. Every original plan/raw-result hash is checked against saved training source_sha256. Cached visual proxies are used only to reproduce historical metadata; no physical fact is certified.
diagnostic_limitations: Journal evaluator may report first blocking predicate rather than every unsatisfied prerequisite; counts are recorded rejection counts, not an exhaustive causal decomposition.
Legacy action stages are motion-pattern labels and can call an articulated contact action lift/transport; typed gate requirements, not the raw stage name, determine applicability.
A predicted grasp-then-lift command ordering alone proves no successful contact; it may identify a distinct within-block recovery supervision gap, not permit an unknown physical state through.
No visual quality, absolute observation/source binding, or witness registry certificate is invented.
compatibility_diagnostic: Initial isolated helper import omitted existing LIBERO_CONFIG_PATH and stopped at a dataset-path prompt/EOF before diagnosis; corrected read-only process pointed to existing .libero config. No source files, protocol or model changed.

conclusion.next_step: Inspect current/within-block evidence appropriate to the actually rejected predicates; do not modify task templates, DAG, thresholds or acceptance from this audit alone.
conclusion.previously_certified_physical_state_was_: 130 of 136 recorded rejection predicate occurrences inherited UNKNOWN->UNKNOWN, rather than a known grasp/lift TRUE becoming invalid; 6 occurrences are previous TRUE pose/reachability. This is not proof of actual current contact or permission to proceed. It identifies where a root prior with unestablished holding facts and attribution provenance differs from a measured physical contradiction.

small_ordered_recovery_gap.note: Only one of 100 rejected candidates has a later closing command followed by the upward-motion pattern. Do not auto-certify its grasp: the action-order signature is a supervision/design diagnostic only.
